g.title: seq
g.text: 07d Payment and settlement: how money moves from the Treasury Single Account to the payee (Modified Disbursement System)

a.text: 1. DBM to Servicing banks: NCA: limit for the
MDS sub-account of the agency
2. Accounting unit: Books: debit Cash-MDS,
Regular, credit Subsidy from National
Government. Registry of the NCA. No official
receipt is issued for an NCA
3. Cash unit to Servicing banks: Payment order
(LDDAP-ADA) in three copies and summary list
(SLIIE) in two, on paper or through the
electronic facility of the bank
4. Accounting unit: Books, on the day of the
daily report: credit Cash-MDS, Regular
5. Servicing banks: Check the payment order
and the NCA balance. Debit the MDS sub-account
(the NCA balance decreases)
6. Servicing banks to Suppliers and payees:
Direct credit, not earlier than 24 hours and
not later than 48 hours after receipt
7. Servicing banks to Suppliers and payees:
Bank transfer. The payee bears the bank charge
8. Servicing banks to BTr: One copy of the
summary list and of the payment order on the
same day: notice of the amount to be
replenished

a.xlink:title: end of: Payee has an account in the same bank
end of: Payee has an account in another bank

a.text: 9. BTr to BSP: Instruction to replenish the
servicing bank
10. Treasury Single Account to Servicing
banks: Debit the Treasury account, credit the
account of the bank at BSP
11. BTr: Books of the Treasury: debit Subsidy
to NGAs, credit Cash in Bank
12. Servicing banks to Cash unit: Validated
copy of the payment order. Items that could
not be credited are marked
13. Accounting unit: For an item not credited:
journal entry to cancel it, and a new payment
order. Each month: reconcile the books with
the bank statement of the sub-account
